bio: The Slaughters Country Inn situated right in the heart of the beautiful Cotswolds, is a truly splendid 17th century hotel, standing in four acres of beautiful grounds alongside the River Eye in the centre of Lower Slaughter. It is complete with traditional beamed ceilings, stone mullioned windows and the most magnificent fireplace.  Afternoon Tea is served daily between 12pm and 5pm and can be enjoyed in the bar, Windsor lounge or on the terrace in summer months. The menu includes a chef's selection of elegant finger sandwiches, fruit and plain scones with clotted cream and seasonal preserves, and a selection of delicious cakes.  The Slaughters Country Inn is the perfect place for a country break where wellies, walks and unwinding are the order of the day. It is located in Lower Slaughter and a short distance from Moreton-in-Marsh or Kingham station.
